### Informations supplémentaires {style="margin-bottom: 30px;"}

::: column-page
```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

tib_tags <- tibble::tibble(
  headings = c(
    'Analyses génomiques 🧬',
    'Phylogénie moléculaire 🌲',
    'Analyse transcriptomique 📊',
    'Visualisation de données 📈',
    'Bioinformatique structurale 🔍'
  ),
  text = 'Duis imperdiet, est vitae mollis porttitor, neque metus ornare urna, a ullamcorper dolor sem at tellus.' 
) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(
    headings = purrr::map(
      headings, 
      \(x) htmltools::div(htmltools::strong(x))
    ),
    text = purrr::map(
      text, 
      htmltools::div
    ),
    combined = purrr::map2(
      headings,
      text,
      \(x, y) htmltools::div(
        style = htmltools::css(
          width = '300px',
          margin_right = '20px',
          margin_bottom = '20px'
        ),
        x, 
        y
      )
    )
  )
htmltools::div(
  style = htmltools::css(
    display = 'flex',
    flex_wrap = 'wrap'
  ),
  tib_tags$combined
)
```
:::

### Partie interactive

```{r}
#| context: setup
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(bslib)
library(ggplot2)
```


```{r}
#| column: page
layout_sidebar(
  height = 600,
  sidebar = sidebar(
    shiny::selectizeInput(
      'select_species', 
      'Espèces à mettre en évidence', 
      choices = c('Adelie', 'Chinstrap', 'Gentoo'),
      selected = c('Adelie', 'Chinstrap', 'Gentoo'),
      multiple = TRUE
    ),
    shiny::sliderInput(
      'slider_weight',
      'Poids minimum (g)',
      min = 1000,
      max = 5000,
      value = 3000
    ),
    shiny::selectInput(
      'plot_type',
      'Type de graphique pour la partie inférieure',
      choices = c('Boxplot', 'Histogramme', 'Densité'),
      selected = 'Boxplot'
    )
  ),
  shiny::plotOutput('output_plot'),
  htmltools::br(),
  htmltools::h4("Analyse supplémentaire"),
  shiny::plotOutput('second_plot')
)
```

```{r}
#| context: server
# Render the plot based on user inputs
output$output_plot <- shiny::renderPlot({
  palmerpenguins::penguins |> 
    dplyr::filter(
      species %in% input$select_species,
      body_mass_g >= input$slider_weight
    ) |> 
    ggplot(
      aes(
        x = bill_length_mm, 
        y = flipper_length_mm, 
        fill = species
      )
    ) +
    geom_point(
      shape = 21, 
      size = 6, 
      col = 'black'
    ) +
    labs(
      x = 'Longueur du bec (mm)',
      y = 'Longueur des nageoires (mm)',
      fill = 'Espèce',
      title = 'Manchots de l\'archipel Palmer'
    ) +
    theme_minimal(
      base_size = 20, 
      base_family = 'Source Sans Pro'
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        Adelie = '#0072B2', 
        Gentoo = '#009E73',
        Chinstrap = '#CC79A7'
      ),
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(
      xlim = c(30, 60), 
      ylim = c(170, 240)
    )
})

# Second plot - dynamic based on user selection
output$second_plot <- shiny::renderPlot({
  # Filter data based on user inputs
  filtered_data <- palmerpenguins::penguins |> 
    dplyr::filter(
      species %in% input$select_species,
      body_mass_g >= input$slider_weight
    )
  
  # Create different plot types based on selection
  if(input$plot_type == "Boxplot") {
    p <- filtered_data |> 
      ggplot(aes(x = species, y = bill_depth_mm, fill = species)) +
      geom_boxplot() +
      labs(
        x = "Espèce",
        y = "Profondeur du bec (mm)",
        title = "Distribution de la profondeur du bec par espèce"
      )
  } else if(input$plot_type == "Histogramme") {
    p <- filtered_data |> 
      ggplot(aes(x = body_mass_g, fill = species)) +
      geom_histogram(binwidth = 200, alpha = 0.7, position = "identity") +
      labs(
        x = "Poids corporel (g)",
        y = "Nombre",
        title = "Distribution du poids corporel"
      )
  } else {
    p <- filtered_data |> 
      ggplot(aes(x = bill_length_mm, fill = species)) +
      geom_density(alpha = 0.7) +
      labs(
        x = "Longueur du bec (mm)",
        y = "Densité",
        title = "Distribution de la longueur du bec"
      )
  }
  
  # Apply common theme and color palette
  p + theme_minimal(
    base_size = 18, 
    base_family = 'Source Sans Pro'
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      Adelie = '#0072B2', 
      Gentoo = '#009E73',
      Chinstrap = '#CC79A7'
    )
  )
})
```
